summary: Backend testing completed for push notification integration in Stripe webhook handlers. All 17 tests passed. The implementation correctly sends push notifications to organizers when ticket sales occur via checkout.session.completed and payment_intent.succeeded webhooks.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ checkout.session.completed handler sends notification with: attendee name, event title, sale amount, ticket count (lines 420-461)
✅ payment_intent.succeeded handler sends notification for at-door payments (lines 542-584)
✅ Both handlers save notifications to 'notifications' database table for in-app notification center
✅ Notification payload includes all required fields: eventId, registrationId, attendeeName, ticketCount, amount, currency, url
✅ NotificationSettings component shows correct notification types including 'New ticket sales' and 'At-door payments'
✅ VAPID keys are configured in backend/.env (VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY, VAPID_SUBJECT)
✅ PushService handles missing subscriptions gracefully (returns false)
✅ Webhook endpoint exists at /api/webhook and correctly rejects invalid signatures
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push notification integration for ticket sales is fully implemented and tested. The system sends browser push notifications AND saves to the notifications database when: 1) checkout.session.completed fires (regular ticket sales), 2) payment_intent.succeeded fires (at-door payments). NotificationSettings component in Settings page allows organizers to enable/disable push notifications.

checkout_session_completed_notification.notification_body: ✅ Includes attendee name, ticket count, event title, currency, amount

payment_intent_succeeded_notification.notification_body: ✅ Includes attendee name, event title, currency, amount

notification_settings_component.notification_types_displayed: ✅ Shows: New ticket sales, At-door payments, Check-in confirmations, Event reminders, Event updates, Refund notifications
